question: January 2022, researchers at the IIT Kharagpur have developed a new highly accurate, portable, yet user-friendly, affordable and non-invasive device for detecting ___________ in resource-constrained clinical settings.
solution:
The correct answer is __**oral cancer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Researchers at IIT Kharagpur have developed a device specifically for detecting **oral cancer**.
 
• The device is designed to be **highly accurate, portable, user-friendly, affordable, and non-invasive**.
 
• This innovation is particularly significant for **resource-constrained clinical settings**, where access to advanced medical technology may be limited.
 
• The development of this device aims to facilitate early detection and treatment, thereby improving patient outcomes and reducing healthcare costs.
